title: The Secret of Tremendous Corporation
reason: Production approval was withdrawn after the pinned Steam-tag source exposed third-party asset exceptions that are not covered by the current blanket open-license record. The asset ledger now records all 33 separately credited third-party works: 23 are clear under preserved CC0/CC-BY/CC-BY-SA evidence, four are known restrictive blockers, and six remain unresolved or provisional. The current Version 6 game data must remain out of production until every production-blocking ledger entry is resolved or replaced and the rebuilt/exact payload is audited again.
